items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Paul Chang was full Chinese, the drummer was full Hawaiian, my tenor player was Hawaiian-Chinese...

ctx.x: One thing we could get in here now is, when we were playing...we'll do it over again... At the time we recorded originally, you couldn't remember the name of your other saxophone player in Honolulu.

It was Paul Chang. So I really had an international band. Paul Chang was full Chinese, the drummer was full Hawaiian, my tenor player was Hawaiian-Chinese, the piano player was Filipino-Chinese-Hawaiian.

And the funny thing about the Islands, everybody is proud of their heritage. They can tell you every branch of their family, and I can almost, too. For instance, my family came from Barbados, but... Did I have this before? Maybe.
